message.content: {"caption":"Two side-by-side agent case studies show retrieved skills guiding task completion in WebShop and ALFWorld.","description":"A two-panel text-based diagram. The left panel, headed “WebShop” with a shopping-cart icon, gives the task of finding a women’s long-sleeve button-down shirt in navy blue, size large, machine washable, and under $40. A pale green “Retrieved Skills” box identifies the task type as apparel and lists “General Skills” and “Task-Specific Skills,” separated by an ellipsis. In the pale pink trace below, Step 1 says the agent is at the WebShop homepage with a search bar. It cites [gen_001] “Prioritize Core Keywords” and [app_001] “Focus Key Query,” then shows a search action for a women’s long-sleeve navy button-down shirt; the query text is cut off after “machine …”. Step 9 reports Navy Blue, size L, and a price of $29.99. The agent cites [app_004] “Check Variant Price,” [app_005] “Confirm Hidden Specs,” and [gen_013] “Purchase Decisively,” then performs “click[Buy Now].” A green check mark indicates success. The right panel, headed “ALFWorld” with a small house-like icon, gives the task of heating an egg and putting it on the countertop. Its pale green retrieved-skills box identifies the task type as heat and lists “General Skills” and “Task-Specific Skills,” also separated by an ellipsis. In the pale pink trace, Step 1 says the agent is in the middle of a room and is looking around. It cites [gen_010] “Progressive Goal Decomposition,” [hea_004] “No Appliance Before Object,” and [hea_001] “Secure Exact Target First”; it says to find the egg and check the fridge and countertops rather than go to the microwave first, then shows an action to go to countertop 1. Step 8 says the agent arrives at countertop 1, cites [hea_005] “place the heated egg directly,” and shows “put egg 1 in/on countertop 1.” A green check mark indicates success. The panels present sequential observations, skill-guided reasoning, and actions; no arrows or other directional connectors are shown.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
